title: Isothrum
shortDescription: Draw a network lab, run it on your own machine, open a console on its machines and capture their traffic.
description:
Isothrum is the desktop app for the Isothrum network-lab editor. Draw a lab of machines, networks and links on a canvas, then do what a browser can't: run it on your own machine, open a console on any machine, start, stop and snapshot them, and capture their traffic.

What you can do:
- Run / Stop a lab: Isothrum writes the lab's files (generated by Isoloom's library, no CLI needed) and brings it up with Docker Compose, or with Vagrant when the lab has virtual machines
- Console: a shell in a container, SSH to an appliance, or vagrant ssh to a VM, in your terminal
- Screen: a machine's VNC/SPICE display in a viewer
- Start, stop and restart a single machine, with its network intact
- Suspend or resume a link, as if you pulled the cable
- Snapshots: save and restore a machine's state
- Capture traffic on a LAN or a cable, streamed live into Wireshark or saved to a .pcap file
- Live status on the canvas while the lab runs: each machine's state and health, each cable, each LAN

The editor is bundled, so the app works offline. Sign in to isothrum.com to use your account and saved projects.

Requirements: Docker for container labs; Vagrant with VirtualBox for labs with virtual machines; Wireshark to watch captures live. Isothrum finds them on your PATH and in their usual install folders.
releaseNotes:
- First Microsoft Store release of Isothrum.
- Draw, run, console into, snapshot and capture network labs on Windows.
